description: Every contest, election and person id the semantic graph published, by type: the id after cg:<type>: with the Browse slug its entity had ("=" the same text, "" none). Entries are only added (scripts/build/build-graph-id-ledger.mjs, after each records build); the graph build answers an id it no longer has with the entity it became (through the retired election slugs and the person-id merges), and the records check fails when an id stops answering (scripts/lib/graph-id-ledger.mjs).
